admission.justification: Extent discovery, exact lookup, citation source selection and uncertainty handling together keep the same declaration identifiable along all three consuming routes.

guarantee: The writer, recorded reader and live citation path use one source declaration identity for accepted Lean names. When scope blocks that identity for a requested key, the affected symbol lookup has no usable region, and an explicit line range remains available.
title: Source-written Lean declarations keep their identity through symbol anchoring
